About Storytel

Storytel is one of the world’s leading audiobook and ebook streaming services and offers unlimited listening. Storytel is a digital platform provider as well as a comprehensive publishing group. The streaming business area offers subscriptions for audiobooks and e-books under the Storytel and Mofibo brands. Storytel’s publishing business area is carried out through the publishing houses Norstedts, Massolit, StorySide, Printz Publishing, People’s Press, Rabén & Sjögren, B.Wahlströms, Gummerus, Lind & CO and more.

Storytel operates in 25+ markets around the globe and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. 

 

Founded in 2005
